Hi Elena — thanks for the materials. We're ready to proceed; below is the vendor-master checklist we need completed to create the legal entity and wire up PO routing without extra manual steps. I attached the MasterProfile_Form_v2.xlsx for structured intake (you can also paste answers inline).

Required fields (please provide exactly as you want them to appear in our system):
- Legal name (legal entity as on W-9)
- Entity type (e.g., C-Corp, LLC)
- Tax ID / EIN (last 4 digits acceptable for initial intake)
- Registered address (street, city, state, postal)
- Remit address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name, phone, email
- Preferred PO format (example: ASP-123-PO000123) and whether NetLedger can include a static prefix
- ERP mapping notes: if you want PO -> GL suggestions, include sample GL codes and short descriptions

Optional (speeds up mapping):
- Preferred invoice delivery (email AP inbox, portal upload, EDI)
- Whether you accept PO-less invoices for implementation-phase purchases

Two options for returning data: 1) complete MasterProfile_Form_v2.xlsx and upload to our secure intake folder (link below) or 2) email the key fields and we can draft the vendor record and send back for sign-off. For international wiring we handle wire vs ACH per the remit address — include SWIFT/IBAN if non-US.

Internal notes: CC'd Karthik (billing integrations) for any NetLedger-specific mapping; Jonas will own the vendor record creation and will reach out if we need any notarized docs.

Secure intake link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzArcSpanOnboarding

Hi Elena — thanks for the completed form. A couple implementation notes from infra/finance side:

- PO integration: we can accept a NetLedger prefix (ASP-) and map to our PO parsing logic so POs from ArcSpan auto-populate in receiving. We'll set the PO pattern as ASP-\d{3}-PO\d{6} for the first rollout; please confirm if that regex works for your numbering.
- GL mapping: we typically leave GL codes blank unless the supplier requests pre-mapped defaults. If you want defaults, include a mapping table (sample GL code + description).
- Invoice delivery: we recommend portal upload (preferred) or sending to ap@arcspan.co (your external AP address). For now we'll enable portal + email fallback.
- Wire instructions: for international wires, please provide SWIFT/IBAN and the beneficiary name exactly as the legal name on the W-9 to avoid hold-ups.

Next steps: Jonas will create the vendor record in our staging environment and share a preview for your AP team to confirm. Once approved we will send a DocuSign for the vendor terms (envelope ID above) and flip the record to production. Expect a preview in 24–48 business hours.
